Import limitations

Two weapons cannot be told apart from the export: Chainsword vs Astartes Chainsword, and the Bolt Rifle firing modes (Focused Fire or Saturation). If your list needs one of them, the import stops and your saved roster is kept. This importer has not yet been checked against a real Blood Angels export.

Rules and points

Black Rage can apply when any one of its listed conditions is met. The app cannot check battlefield positions. Legacy of the Angel only applies to a BLOOD ANGELS CHARACTER. General Space Marines units do not automatically count as BLOOD ANGELS. Check Stormlance against your rules, as the available references disagree. Some rules are shown in full but are not applied automatically. To calculate paid equipment costs, the app needs to know exactly what was selected, how many, and who has it; otherwise the points total stays unresolved.
